newsitem.title: USA: Possis votes shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Possis votes shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Possis Medical Inc said Thursday its board adopted a shareholder rights plan which provides protection against hostile takeovers and market activities that could result in a sale of the company.
One right will be issued for each common share outstanding on December 23.

Possis, which develops medical devices for cardiovascular treatment markets, said each right will entitle a shareholder to buy one one-hundredth of the company's newly created Series A junior participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $160.

The rights will become exercisable if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of Possis' common shares. The company may redeem the rights at $0.01 per right at certain times. The rights expire December 23, 2006.
Possis said it did not adopt the rights plan in response to any specific takeover proposal.
